annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin as “THE NEW BITCOIN” and directs viewers to register for an investment-related offer. It also shows or instructs viewers to create an account or log in to a OneCoin-branded wallet to upload, withdraw, and manage funds. The upgrade-package tutorial framing and wallet dashboard support participation involving deposits and transfers.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S05 is the closest supported Stage II subtype because the primary text links OneCoin to an investment-related registration prompt and presents OneCoin as "THE NEW BITCOIN." The supplied evidence does not explicitly establish a token purchase, appreciation, listing gain, dividend, or holding-return claim, so the fit remains partial.
